描述_EN: in the night garden is a popular children's television series shown on cbeebies featuring a range of colourful characters who care deeply for one another. igglepiggle is one of the main characters and takes the form of a blue, teddy-like toy. blanket time igglepiggle can sing, dance, and play games, all of which are designed to revolve around his red blanket. in the programme he is always seen carrying his red blanket, which is reflected in this interactive soft toy, made by hasbro in 2007.
描述_ZN: 《夜花园》是一个流行的儿童电视系列节目，在Cbeebies上播放，其中有一系列色彩斑斓的人物，他们彼此之间相互关心。 igglepiggle是主要人物之一，外形是一个蓝色的、类似泰迪的玩具。 毯子时间igglepiggle可以唱歌、跳舞和玩游戏，所有这些都是围绕他的红色毯子而设计的。 在节目中，他总是带着他的红色毛毯，这也反映在这个互动的软玩具中，由hasbro在2007年制作。
